fields.title: OurRoom
fields.summary: A private shared space for two people - realtime messaging with voice notes and reactions, WebRTC calls, shared files, playlists, notes and calendar. Flask + Socket.IO on Render with Neon Postgres, S3 object storage, and push notifications to web and Android.
fields.tech_stack: Flask, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, WebRTC, S3, Render

fields.title: Rebuilding calkindev.nz
fields.body: This site had been sitting untouched for a while, so I gave it a proper refresh. Not a rewrite - the stack is still Vite, TypeScript and SCSS with Bulma underneath - but a round of changes that make it feel finished rather than scaffolded.
